title: Moris Metrics
description: Working a custom software solutions which helps SMEs tackle data cleaning.
fullDescription: Data is only as valuable as its accessibility. In the Mauritian market, critical insights are often fragmented, buried in spreadsheets, or difficult to visualize. Moris Metrics was born from the need to turn complex local data into a competitive advantage.
overview: Data is only as valuable as its accessibility. In the Mauritian market, critical insights are often fragmented, buried in spreadsheets, or difficult to visualize. Moris Metrics was built to turn complex local data into a practical business advantage.
challenge: SMEs often work with data that is incomplete, inconsistent, or spread across disconnected files. The challenge was to create a product experience that made cleaning and understanding that data feel approachable instead of technical.
strategy: We focused on a clear workflow for importing, reviewing, and improving business data. The visual system and interface prioritize confidence, legibility, and fast decision-making for users who may not have a data team.
solution: The resulting platform combines a modern web interface with a structured data workflow, giving teams a clearer way to manage messy information and extract useful insights. The brand and UI support a product that feels local, practical, and trustworthy.
